artworks.title: The Flaying of Marsyas
artworks.medium: pen and brown and black ink with brown wash, heightened with white gouache, on brown prepared laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring two figures interacting with an animal pelt. The artwork shows two muscular figures, minimally dressed, engaging with the pelt. One figure is facing the pelt and holding it, while the other figure stands behind, observing. The drawing is detailed, emphasizing the figures' movement and the pelt's hanging structure. The traditional style showcases precise anatomy and shading, creating depth. A tree trunk or pillar supports the pelt in the composition.

artworks.title: Charity
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper, laid down
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing with four individuals. On the right, a seated person is holding a child, both wearing simplified garments. On the left, two children are depicted climbing a tree. The background includes a sketched tree, clouds, and shading for a natural setting. The drawing is monochrome with emphasis on lines and shading.

artworks.title: Woodland Path
artworks.medium: pastel on laid paper, laid down on cardboard
artworks.description: The image displays a path winding through a woodland area, seen from a low vantage point. The horizon is not clearly visible due to the focus on the trees and the path. The brushstrokes convey a soft and fluid style, creating an impressionistic quality. The color palette is dominated by green and blue tones, with hints of brown and tan. The trees are depicted with loosely defined, blurred forms, suggesting movement or dappled light. The path disappears into the shadowy trees in the distance.

artworks.title: La Bonne Aventure
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate (cut within platemark at right): 40.3 x 30 cm (15 7/8 x 11 13/16 in.)
sheet: 47.4 x 31.8 cm (18 11/16 x 12 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a ground-level view of a lush landscape with dense trees and foliage crowding the upper portion. A group of elegantly dressed figures, predominantly women, converse among the trees, while a few sheep are visible to the right. The scene is rendered with intricate engraving, creating detailed textures in the leaves and clothing. The color palette is monochrome with sepia tones, emphasizing light and shade. Stone structures are faintly visible in the background.

artworks.title: La Bonne Aventure
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper (proof)
artworks.dimensions:
image (cut within platemark): 35.5 x 27.9 cm (14 x 11 in.)
sheet: 40 x 30 cm (15 3/4 x 11 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with sheep resting on grass, surrounded by plant life and an old tree. Figures in robes are gathered in conversation or observation, with architectural elements in the background. The drawing depicts light and shadow in a detailed woodland setting.

artworks.title: Abraham Entertaining the Angels
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Japanese paper
artworks.description: Printed with delicate lines or heavy shading on cream-white paper, two elderly men and two others with wings sit on or stand near a cloth laid with food just in front of the open, deeply shadowed doorway of a house in this vertical etching and drypoint. The men and angels take up the lower third of the composition. One angel with a beard and long hair pulled back under a band sits facing our right in profile along the left edge of the print. Next is a man with a chest-length white beard, a long headdress, and a lined face. He holds the foot of a shallow chalice in one hand and gestures to an oval tray holding objects, presumably bread, on the cloth. The next person also has a beard and wings, and the fourth, near the right edge of the print, stands next to the cloth so he is visible from the waist up. His face is also heavily lined, and he has a long white beard and a fringe of bushy hair around a balding head. One hand rests on a long-necked ewer as he stoops slightly toward the cloth. The arched doorway stands open to the left, behind the first angel and man. A person peeks around the edge of the door from deep shadows. Heavy veils drape over the head and down the sides of the face and neck, and that person holds one hand up to their chest. A child clamors onto the top surface of a low wall just outside the doorway, which presumably encloses a stoop or landing. Trees fill most of the background in the right half. The artist signed and dated the plate, barely legible in the shadows, “Rembrandt f. 1656.”

artworks.title: Christ as Salvator Mundi
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a bearded man standing with one arm raised. He has long hair and a prominent beard, wearing a robe that covers most of his body. His right hand is extended with two fingers raised, while his left hand holds a globe topped with a cross. The background shows a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: Pines in a Morning Fog
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is of a landscape with tall, slender trees in the foreground. The horizon is low, with mist or fog obscuring the distance. The style features fine brushstrokes detailing the trees against a hazy background. The color palette is muted, with greens and browns in the trees blending into the sky's soft blue and warm orange tones, suggesting either dawn or dusk.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child in Glory with Saints John the Baptist, Stephen, and Lawrence
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk, heightened with white, on light brown oatmeal paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures under a heavenly scene. In the image, we see three seated figures gazing upwards towards a collection of cherubs and a central divine figure, all set on a cloud. The drawing is skillfully rendered with loose, fluid lines, capturing both movement and emotion. The heavenly figures, surrounded by cherubs, add a sense of divine presence to the scene, while the contrasting earthly figures contribute to a discourse between the terrestrial and the celestial.

artworks.title: A Battle on a Bridge
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with blue wash over black chalk, squared for transfer in black chalk, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The drawing depicts figures engaged in combat, including warriors on foot and horseback. The composition shows movement and energy, with figures wielding weapons like spears and shields, and horses in mid-gallop. A blue wash adds depth and contrast to the monochrome sketch, highlighting the musculature of the figures and animals. The scene is set on an elevated platform or bridge, with figures falling or tumbling over the edge, adding drama and action to the artwork.

artworks.title: Salome with the Head of St. John the Baptist
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown wash and black chalk, heightened with white gouache and squared for transfer in black chalk, on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a group of figures in a dramatic pose. The image features well-defined human forms, showcasing anatomy and movement. In the foreground, there are two outlined figures; one with a muscular back and another reaching out with a draped garment. Several other figures appear in the background, creating depth and interaction. Shading and cross-hatching techniques give volume and texture to the composition, and grid lines suggest it may be a preparatory sketch for a larger work or fresco. The figures exude a classical feel, emphasizing dynamic gesture and elegant drapery.

artworks.title: Saint Zenobius Resuscitating a Child
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper, squared for transfer in black chalk
artworks.description: The image features multiple figures engaged in a scene. The characters are depicted with sketchy, expressive lines. The composition includes a structured background with architectural elements. The figures are dressed in flowing garments.

artworks.title: Study for a Reliquary Sarcophagus
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sculpture with two cherubs positioned on either side of a rectangular pedestal. The cherubs have small wings and curly hair, interacting with a garland on top of the structure. The sculpture appears to be made of material resembling carved stone or marble, with a monochromatic color palette ranging from light beige to darker brown tones. The pedestal is ornate with classical scroll motifs on the corners and a sturdy base. The overall look conveys classical elegance and harmony, with the cherubs adding a playful element.

artworks.title: Saint Paul Preaching in Athens
artworks.medium: pen and black and gray ink with gray wash, heightened with white gouache, on tan prepared paper

artworks.title: Salome with the Head of Saint John the Baptist
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor and brown-gray wash over black chalk, with touches of red chalk in Salom's lips and by her mouth, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a figure, focusing on a young woman who is looking at the viewer. Her facial features are delicately rendered with soft shading. Her hair is styled in an updo with accessories. She is dressed in a flowing garment with folds, highlighted with color. She is holding a platter with a man's head. In the background, there is a sketched figure of an older man. The background features earthy colors.

artworks.title: Satan Challenges God to Remove his Protection from Job
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over traces of graphite on laid paper, incised for transfer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a central bearded figure seated on clouds holding an orb, gesturing towards surrounding figures. Numerous figures are depicted standing and seated on clouds, appearing engaged in discourse or gathering. Some figures face the central figure while others interact with each other. Winged figures are seen in the upper left corner and among the clouds. Musculature and draped fabrics are detailed, adding dynamism. An orb is present, potentially symbolizing power or authority. Fine lines and cross-hatching provide depth and texture in the composition.

artworks.title: Village Landscape
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray and gray-brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a village street with various buildings and trees silhouetted against the sky. A group of five figures is gathered near a tall, dilapidated structure on the left. The path winds past quaint houses to the right, with a church tower in the distance. Tall, leafy trees take up the right edge of the image. The drawing is done in fine pen and ink strokes, creating a detailed monochromatic scene in shades of grey. The sky contains a few clouds and two small birds in flight.

artworks.title: Extensive Landscape Seen from the Edge of a Forest
artworks.medium: pen and gray and brown ink with gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape drawn from an elevated point of view. Shrubs and grass are textured in the foreground, with a tree extending its branches in the top left corner. The horizon is high, with undulating distant land and a small village with a spired building, likely a church. The drawing features fine brushstrokes detailing foliage, architecture, and terrain. The color palette is subdued with earthy browns and muted grays. The sky is softly rendered, providing a calm atmosphere and vast open space in the composition.

artworks.title: The Blessed in Paradise with the Virgin and St. John the Baptist before God
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper, laid down
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures in a celestial scene. The figures are arranged in tiers surrounded by clouds and possibly gathered around a central figure. They are portrayed with simple outlines and are engaged in various activities such as playing musical instruments. The drawing uses lines and shading to create depth and texture.

artworks.title: Tanjore, India
artworks.medium: gray and black wash over traces of graphite on card
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with an intricately designed temple on the right side. The temple has a pyramidal structure with detailed patterns. In the background, there are other temple-like silhouettes on the horizon. Some tall trees are in the foreground, contrasting with the man-made structure. Vegetation and rocks are visible to the left. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing form and shadow.

artworks.title: Bacchanal with a Dancing Couple on the Right
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical beings in a forest setting. The scene shows a group of figures in lively interaction amidst a forest landscape. The figures are depicted in dynamic poses, suggesting movement and perhaps a sense of celebration or playfulness. The background features intricate depictions of trees and foliage, creating a dense, lush forest environment. Fine lines and cross-hatching are used to create depth and texture in the trees and figures. The composition captures a moment of interaction between the figures and their natural surroundings, conveying a sense of harmony with nature.

artworks.title: Gate to the Farmhouse, Pont-Aven
artworks.medium: graphite and charcoal on tan paper
artworks.creditLine: Agnew's London, in honor of Dr. Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch showing a low stone fence with a gate in the center and flanked by low stone walls. The view leads to a small house in the middle of the scene, surrounded by sparse trees and bushes. The horizon is high as the land gently slopes upward. In the sky, there are cloud-like shapes. The sketch is done with varying intensity pencil strokes to create texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic graphite on paper.

artworks.title: Two Actors Peeking through a Theater Curtain while Others Prepare the Footlights
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical scene. The image shows a stage setting with curtains, architectural columns on either side, and figures engaging in the mid-century European theatrical scene. Two heads peek through a gap in the curtains at the center. On the left, one figure appears to be gesturing or reacting beside another figure who leans toward the floor, while on the right, another figure holds a candle, illuminating the space around them. Italian text is present below the scene. The artistic style is characteristic of engravings or drawings from the 18th century, featuring detailed line work and a formal composition.

artworks.title: Jupiter and Danaë
artworks.medium: pastel manner on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: The image shows a person laying on a bed. They are positioned on their side with their right arm behind their head. The person has a serene expression, full cheeks, and short curly hair with leaves and flowers. They are partially covered with a cloth and have a butterfly on their hip. The bed has colorful covers, and the background features clouds, a bird, and scattered gold coins.
